intro: Gordo's Task is an errand in Tirisfal Glades given by Gordo, a wandering abomination trying to gather flora along the road to Brill. Unsuited for delicate fieldwork, he recruits travelers to pick Gloom Weed and deliver it to his handler, Junior Apothecary Holland.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Master want weeds. Us gots big hands and not good at picking. You help us and we not hurt you. Us need gloom weed. Many weeds around here and near road.
When you have gloom weed you take to Master Holland in Brill graveyard.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Where's that useless abomination? Either you have what I need or you'd best get out there and find it.

clips.title: Completion
paras: What's this? Gloom weed?! I've no need for gloom weed! That mindless mass of flesh is out there picking daisies and convincing the Lady knows how many dupes like you into doing the same. No offense.
Very well, you're here now and that's all that matters. Since I'm not going to bother to try to explain things to that abomination how about you collect what I really need... Doom weed!
